## 📝 Pull Request Description

Please include a summary of the changes you've made. Are you adding a new framework to `reference/frameworks.md`, refining the logic in `skill.md`, or patching a bug?

*Detail your changes here.*

## 🛠 Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (fixes an issue with the AI's logic or formatting)
- [ ] 🧠 New Framework (adds a new behavioral principle)
- [ ] 🚀 Prompt Optimization (improves `skill.md` instructions)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update (modifies README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)

## ✅ Definition of Done

Before submitting, please ensure you have completed the following:

- [ ] I have tested these changes with at least one major AI model (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini).
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines.
- [ ] I have updated the `reference/frameworks.md` if applicable.
- [ ] My markdown formatting is clean and consistent.

## 🔗 Related Issues

If this PR fixes an open issue, please link it here (e.g., `Closes #123`).
